jobs.occupation: Business Analyst IAM - IT Production Security - HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

You’ll be the go-to expert in Privileged Access Management (PAM) within our IAM Evolution Squad, driving the security and efficiency of access governance at BNP Paribas Fortis. 

Your mission? Design, implement, and optimize PAM solutions using CyberArk and SailPoint, ensuring compliance with strict banking regulations while collaborating with IT, security, and business teams.

This is your chance to shape the future of secure access in a global bank, working in a hybrid setup (50% remote, 50% on-site in Brussels) with a skilled, multicultural team of 10 specialists.

 

AND IN DETAIL

What You’ll Own:

• Lead PAM Strategy & Execution: As the Privileged Access Management (PAM) Subject Matter Expert (SME), you’ll own the design, implementation, and optimization of CyberArk-based solutions, ensuring they meet security, compliance, and operational needs.
• Strengthen Access Governance: Work closely with IAM, IT Security, Compliance, and Risk teams to align access policies with BNP Paribas Fortis standards and regulatory requirements.
• Drive Process Improvement: Use KPIs and data-driven insights to refine access management workflows, reducing risks and enhancing efficiency.
• Collaborate & Train: Partner with cross-functional teams to implement best practices and upskill colleagues on PAM and IAM protocols.
• Innovate with Cutting-Edge Tools: Leverage SailPoint, CyberArk, and ServiceNow to build a scalable, adaptive identity framework.
 

Why It Matters: 
 You’re not just managing access, you’re protecting critical banking systems, ensuring compliance, and enabling secure, seamless operations for thousands of users. 

Your work will directly impact how we mitigate risks, enforce policies, and future-proof our security infrastructure.

Your Team & Environment:

• A squad of 10 (Business Analysts, Security Officers, Product Owner, Scrum Master) based in Montagne-Du-Parc, Brussels.
• A hybrid work model (50% remote, 50% on-site) for flexibility and collaboration.
• A culture of innovation, where you’ll help transition access governance into a dynamic, compliance-first, AI-augmented capability.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

Non-Negotiables (Must-Haves)

• 10+ years in security technology, with deep expertise in:
• Identity & Access Management (IAM)
• Privileged Access Management (PAM), CyberArk experience mandatory
• Segregation of Duties (SoD) & Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) 
• Hands-on experience with:
• SailPoint, Cloud (IaaS/PaaS), ServiceNow, Process Management Tools
• Designing requirements, specifications, and use cases 
• CISSP Certification (or equivalent) 
• Languages:
• English (fluent, written & spoken)
• Dutch and/or French is an asset
 

What Sets You Apart

• Analytical & Conceptual Thinker: You break down complex problems and design practical, scalable solutions. 
• Strong Negotiator & Influencer : You align stakeholders, drive decisions, and get buy-in for critical security initiatives.
• Proactive & Resilient: You take ownership, adapt quickly, and deliver under pressure.
• Strict on Execution: You track progress meticulously and ensure no detail is overlooked
• Team Player in a Multicultural Setting: You collaborate smoothly with diverse, high-performing teams.

As a Senior Information Security Officer, you are the strategic leader who defines, drives and strengthens Luminus’ cybersecurity vision across the entire organization. You ensure that our IT, OT, business operations, subsidiaries and affiliates are protected against evolving cyber threats while supporting our mission to deliver reliable and secure energy services to millions of customers.

What you'll do

• You define and implement a company-wide cybersecurity strategy aligned with Luminus’ business objectives, risk appetite and regulatory requirements.
• Identify, assess, prioritize and report cybersecurity risks to executive leadership and governance bodies, while ensuring compliance with regulations such as NIS, GDPR and other applicable cybersecurity frameworks.
• You develop and maintain security policies, standards and governance frameworks, and ensure their effective adoption across the organization, subsidiaries and affiliates.
• Build and manage the cybersecurity roadmap, driving initiatives that strengthen resilience, compliance and operational efficiency while building on the strong foundations already in place.
• You work closely with IT, OT, business leaders, the Data Protection Officer, security operations teams and the Information Security Forum to integrate security into key activities and create alignment across the organization.
• Represent Luminus towards regulators, authorities, auditors and external partners, while chairing the Information Security Forum and influencing stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

What you'll bring

• You have at least 8 years of experience in information security, including a minimum of 5 years in a leadership role.
• Extensive expertise in cybersecurity governance, risk management, security technologies, regulatory compliance and the ability to translate security requirements into business value.
• You communicate confidently with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and can clearly explain security risks, priorities and recommendations to senior management, directors and subsidiary leaders.
• Strong influencing, organizational and prioritization skills, allowing you to build consensus, challenge stakeholders when needed and drive security improvements across a complex organization.
• You hold a relevant master's degree or have acquired equivalent expertise through professional experience.
• Recognized certifications such as CISSP, CISM and ISO 27001 Lead Implementer are required. A good understanding of IT and OT environments, risk management and the energy sector is a strong asset. Fluent English and French are required.

• Take part in the development of software specifications and architectures based on needs expressed by rail experts
• Develop and maintain software components (detailed design, coding, code reviews and testing)
• Perform integration and functional testing of these components in the final products, using physical and digital test platforms
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of our processes, methods, and tools
• Stay up to date with technological developments in the field
• Coordinate software development activities within your scope
• Contribute to planning, progress tracking, and QCD commitments
• Participate in software change management (CCB)
• Identify and escalate risks impacting delivery or quality
 
 
Mandatory skills:

Master's degree or engineering degree (BAC +5) in Electronics, Computer Science, Telecom, Automation, Electricity, Robotics, Mechatronics, or a similar technical field is mandatory.

Experience & technical background

• > 5 years of experience in real-time embedded software development
• Solid experience in development for complex systems
• Proven exposure to railway or other safety-critical environments
• Experience in technical leadership or coordination roles
• Fluent in English and French
Location Charleroi

Schedule: 3 days onsite, 2 days WFH

jobs.occupation: Senior Detection Engineer & Threat Hunting Lead
jobs.description:
Are you a cybersecurity expert who thinks like an attacker? At Randstad Digital, we are looking for a Senior Detection Engineer & Threat Hunting Lead to drive our threat detection and hunting programmes. This is a high-ownership, hands-on role where you will design elite detections, lead incident responses, and eventually build a team around you to secure leading organizations.
 

your responsibilities
 
 

•  

Detection Engineering: Design and maintain SIEM/XDR detection rules with full lifecycle ownership.
  

•  

Gap Analysis: Map coverage blind spots against threat actor TTPs (MITRE ATT&CK).
  

•  

Incident Response: Lead L2/L3 incident response, containment, and remediation efforts.
  

•  

Purple Teaming: Run breach & attack simulations to validate detection coverage.
  

•  

Detection-as-Code: Build and manage frameworks using CI/CD pipelines and version control.
  

•  

Threat Hunting & Intel: Execute hunting hypotheses and translate threat feeds into actionable alerts.
  

•  

Testing & Compliance: Act as the blue team counterpart for red team, TIBER, and DORA testing.
  

•  

Community: Represent the company in industry groups (ISACs, CSIRTs).
   

your profile
 
 

•  

Experience: Several years of hands-on experience in Detection Engineering, SOC, or CSIRT roles.
  

•  

Tech Stack: Deep knowledge of SIEMs (Sentinel, Splunk, QRadar) and SOAR automation.
  

•  

Skills: Expert in attacker TTPs, digital forensics, and incident handling.
  

•  

Languages: Trilingual in English, Dutch, and French.
  

•  

Leadership: Ready to lead a functional working group or mentor a growing team.
   

nice to have
 
 

•  

Background in Government, Defense, Banking, or Critical Infrastructure (OT/ICS).
  

•  

Python scripting for security automation.
  

•  

Certifications: CISSP, CISM, or specialized Threat Hunting/Intel tracks.

As a production worker, you're the driving force behind the production process. You ensure the production line always runs smoothly by replenishing and trimming meat as needed. Don't worry if you don't have experience with knives – you'll learn! You'll also help load and unload trucks and work in various departments, such as production, packaging, and shipping. No two days are the same for a production worker, and that's what makes it so rewarding.
We're looking for a production worker who's a hands-on person.

You're physically fit, speak fluent Dutch or English, and enjoy working independently and as part of a team. As a production worker, you take responsibility, remain calm under pressure, and prioritize effectively.

Flexibility is key: you'll start between 3:30 and 6:30 a.m. and work until everything is finished, OR you'll work in two shifts: from 3:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. and the other week from 1:30 p.m. to 10:30 p.m.

Working in a refrigerated environment? No problem for you!

 

Eager to get stuck in? Then you're the production worker we want on our team!

We're on the lookout for a 
Mid-Level AI Systems Engineer who bridges AI engineering and MLOps. Someone who loves getting hands-on with LLMs, agents, and RAG pipelines, and who cares just as much about what happens once a model reaches production as about building it in the first place. In this role, you'll design, build, deploy, and operate production-grade AI systems, with a strong focus on generative AI, LLM-based applications, and reliable machine learning operations. In practice your time is split roughly between 60-70% AI Engineering and 30-40% MLOps.
 

In this role you sit at the intersection of engineering and operations, working across teams and disciplines. You'll report to the Head of ML at Sagacify and collaborate with the wider Sagacify and Craftzing delivery organisation. A role that can naturally grow towards a Team Lead position over time.
 

What you'll do :
 

AI Engineering (60-70%)
 
 

• Orchestrate AI system components: LLMs, vector databases, APIs, orchestration layers, and user interfaces 

• Develop autonomous agents and conversational systems that can plan actions and interact with external tools or APIs 

• Build and optimise RAG pipelines connecting enterprise data sources to LLMs for grounded, contextualised, reliable answers 

• Evaluate system quality through generative AI metrics, coherence tests, and production monitoring (latency, API costs, bias) 

• Deploy and scale solutions with strong attention to latency, security, reliability and cost efficiency 

• Keep an eye on the ecosystem for new models, frameworks and techniques, including open-source tools such as LangChain, LangGraph, Langfuse, etc. 

• Perform prompt and context engineering to improve output quality, reduce hallucinations, and manage conversational state effectively  

MLOps (30-40%)
 
 

• Build and maintain automation for model deployment, including CI/CD pipelines and automated testing 

• Continuously monitor model performance in production, including drift detection and quality metric tracking 

• Manage updates of libraries, models, and related dependencies in production environments 

• Ensure versioning, reproducibility and safe rollout of models and AI services 

• Collaborate closely with ML engineers, developers, DevOps and infrastructure teams for smooth delivery 

• Stay current with the latest MLOps practices, tools and platform components  

You stay in the code, you stay curious about what happens after deployment, and you keep learning as you go.

 

• You have 3 to 5 years of experience in AI/ML engineering or related fields 

• You have a solid understanding of LLM fundamentals: Transformers, attention mechanisms, generation parameters and fine-tuning approaches 

• You have strong problem-solving ability and algorithmic creativity 

• You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders 

• You have a team spirit and enjoy collaborating across multiple roles 

• You bring rigour, responsiveness and a good incident-handling mindset 

• You're autonomous, curious, and quick to learn new tools 

• You can communicate fluently in Dutch, English and French, or at least the first two languages  

Don’t worry if you don’t tick every single box, what matters most is the right mindset and a drive to learn. If you think we’re a match, we’d love to hear from you.

For our client, an international organization active in Aftermarket services for advanced mobility systems, we are looking for a Technical Customer Trainer who can step in and make an impact. The company focuses on the sales, service, and technical support of advanced powertrain, transmission, and chassis technologies for passenger cars, commercial vehicles, and industrial applications. From Brussels, they support mobility solutions delivered worldwide.
 

Your Role
 

 
• As a Technical Customer Trainer, you will be responsible for transferring technical knowledge to customers, workshops, fleets, and service partners. You will act as a key technical contact, ensuring that customers have the knowledge and tools needed to effectively use and maintain products and systems. 
 

 
 

Key Responsibilities:
 

Training & Knowledge Transfer
 

 
• Deliver technical training programs to customers, service partners, and network organizations.
 
• Ensure accurate and effective transfer of technical product and system knowledge. 
 
• Develop new training programs that respond to market demands and customer needs.
 
• Create and maintain training-related system access and software credentials where required.
 
• Conduct on-site customer training sessions and technical presentations at customer events. 
 

Technical Support
 

 
• Provide technical support to aftermarket customers.
 
• Assist customers with technical questions related to products and systems.
 
• Serve as a subject matter expert for technical solutions and applications.  
 

Customer & Network Development
 

 
• Maintain strong relationships with service workshops, fleets, and industry partners. 
 
• Support the development and maintenance of commercial service networks.
 
• Identify training opportunities and emerging market needs. 

Your Profile:
 

Qualifications & Experience
 

 
• You must have experience providing technical training in the automotive sector.
 
• Strong technical knowledge of commercial vehicle systems and products.
 
• Extensive experience within the automotive commercial vehicle sector, particularly involving trucks, buses, trailers, and air brake systems. 
 
• Experience delivering technical training, coaching, or technical customer support. 
 
• Well-established network within the commercial vehicle service industry is considered an advantage.  
 

 
 

Language Skills
 

 
• Fluent in Dutch, French, and English, both spoken and written.
 
• Comfortable delivering training sessions to international audiences and expatriate teams.  
 

Personal Competencies
 

 
• Excellent presentation and communication skills.
 
• Passion for teaching and developing others.
 
• Customer-oriented and solution-focused mindset. 
 
• Highly motivated to learn and master new technologies and product portfolios.
 
• Flexible and willing to adapt to customer requirements and training locations. 
 
• Strong organizational and stakeholder management skills.

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

AND IN DETAIL
